# Feluqa Documentation

> Documentation for Feluqa, a proprietary platform and unified namespace for building applications across web, workstation, mobile, games, APIs, and real-time systems. The target architecture is still under development.

## Start here

- [Get started](/get-started/) — product direction, setup, and application development.
- [Learn by building](/learn/) — practical application tutorials.

## Reference guides

- [Feluqa](/feluqa/) — product, framework, and developer guidance.
- [Feluqa internals](/internals/) — runtime, workspace, and compile-time architecture.
- [Agents](/agents/) — contribution guidance for AI coding agents.

## Machine-readable resources

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml) — generated index of the published documentation pages.
- [RSS feed](/rss.xml) — machine-readable feed of documentation pages.
- [API schemas](/api/schemas/) — schemas for site configuration and documentation resources.

## Documentation status

This documentation describes a platform in active development. Treat pages marked `Exploring` as provisional and pages marked `Target` as planned product direction. Do not describe planned capabilities as implemented.
